title: Concept: JSF ViewState carried in a response
description: A JavaServer Faces ViewState field in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The ViewState is a serialised server-side object graph, and a server that deserialises it without integrity checking accepts attacker-controlled object streams.
applicability: Deployments that render a JavaServer Faces ViewState field into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The ViewState is a serialised server-side object graph, and a server that deserialises it without integrity checking accepts attacker-controlled object streams.
